source: https://pikapikagems.github.io/yomiage/ (hints and steps copied verbatim from the demo page; labels are ours)

sliders.name: pitch
sliders.label: Pitch
sliders.hint: How high or low the voice is, in semitones (12 = one octave): −2 is slightly lower, −12 an octave down. On its own a big change sounds like the same small speaker sped up or slowed down; combine it with formant for a different-sounding voice.

sliders.name: formant
sliders.label: Formant
sliders.hint: The "size" of the voice: the resonances of the throat and mouth, independent of pitch. Negative sounds like a bigger, deeper body (more mature); positive sounds smaller (younger). Large values start to sound artificial.

sliders.name: breathReduction
sliders.label: Breath reduction
sliders.hint: Softens the hissy, airy high frequencies. Shifted voices pick up some breath noise, so the presets that shift use 0.6. Higher is cleaner, but s and sh sounds get duller.

sliders.name: speed
sliders.label: Speed
sliders.hint: How fast she talks. 1 is the model's natural pace, 0.5 half as fast, 0.25 a quarter as fast, 1.5 half again as fast. Changes the tempo only, not the pitch.

sliders.name: expressiveness
sliders.label: Expressiveness
sliders.hint: How much the tone and intonation vary. Low is flat and steady, a bit robotic; high is livelier but can wobble. (piper's noise scale)

sliders.name: rhythmVariation
sliders.label: Rhythm variation
sliders.hint: How much the length of sounds and pauses varies. Low is metronome-steady; high is more natural but uneven. (piper's noise W)
